description: Source code for HTTP/2 header validation logic within the quiche library, implementing header syntax checks, pseudo-header validation, and header field handling.

classes.name: HeaderValidator
classes.description: Class responsible for validating HTTP/2 headers, including pseudo-header validation, header syntax, and content length handling.

methods.name: StartHeaderBlock
methods.description: Initializes header validation state at the start of a new header block.

methods.name: ValidateSingleHeader
methods.description: Validates individual header fields for correctness and compliance with HTTP/2 rules.

methods.name: FinishHeaderBlock
methods.description: Validates the set of pseudo-headers at the end of a header block based on header type.

methods.name: IsValidHeaderValue
methods.description: Checks if a header value contains only valid characters.

methods.name: IsValidAuthority
methods.description: Validates the authority header value against allowed characters.

methods.name: HandleContentLength
methods.description: Processes and validates the Content-Length header value.

methods.name: ValidateAndSetAuthority
methods.description: Validates and sets the authority value if valid.
